**Design your newsletters, manage them as a team, and a security pass for internet-facing installs**

- **Design without code, or with it.** The new Designs page replaces Templates: pick colours, font, layout, and what each item shows, with a live preview, or switch a design to code for full control. The refreshed Default design groups items by type, puts a show's new episodes on one row, adds **Watch on Plex**-style buttons for your sources, and looks right in dark-mode email apps.
- **More sources.** Jellyfin and Emby join Plex, Tautulli, BookLore, BookOrbit, Grimmory, Audiobookshelf, and RomM. Import users with their emails from any of them. Several sources are marked 🧪 Needs testers in the README; if you run one, please tell us how it goes.
- **Know before, and after, it sends.** Preview exactly what the next newsletter will contain, skip sends when there's nothing new, and get alerted by email, Discord, Slack, ntfy, Apprise, or webhook when a scheduled send fails.
- **Room for more admins, and safer on the internet.** A new Users page lets you add people with temporary passwords, deactivate them, and link them to SSO. A security review hardened sign-in, sessions, and outbound requests, and the container no longer runs as root.

### Before you upgrade

- **Back up your `latestarr-data` volume first,** as with any upgrade. Everything below is migrated automatically when the new version starts.
- **Templates become designs.** Templates built with the old drag-and-drop editor turn into code designs that send exactly as before. Each newsletter's intro, footer note, buttons, and font move into its design.
- **Designs saved before this release keep their settings.** To get the new sections by type, turn on **Group by type** in the design.
- **The container now runs as a regular user, not root.** On first start it takes ownership of `/app/data`, so existing volumes keep working. If you run it with your own `user:` setting, that user needs write access to the data folder.
- **`TRUST_PROXY=true` now takes effect.** Before, Docker Compose never passed it to the container. Only set it if LatestArr is behind a reverse proxy.
